top_signals.title: South Africa’s Sasol Tops EM Peers on Oil-From-Coal Bonanza
top_signals.summary: This year’s oil price rally has produced one clear winner: South Africa’s Sasol Ltd. is the top-performing emerging-market stock outside Asia and many analysts are betting its bull run has further to go.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Sugar Extends Rally to Highest Level Since 2024 on Weather Risks
top_signals.summary: Raw sugar futures extended gains, with worries about tighter global supplies mounting because of weather and production concerns across top growers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
